title: Awesome Tech
description: Unique tech modpack about electricity and kinetics
body:
![awesome tech logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1e5c9c98940a80e5c8365d8c172e51e0aa5c329.png)



This is a modpack that is meant to provide a very good automation experience and excellent mod compatibility, and most importantly it is built using the Fabric mod loader.

It includes many custom recipes and fixes. For example, the tag issues in Create Deco have been fixed, raw crushed ores can be smelted using Hephaestus, and the crafting recipe for Icarus wings is more balanced.
It is also important to mention that I disabled ore duplicates from multiple mods - if an ore exists in one mod, it will not generate in others.

- Build amazing factories with [create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) and its addons, ComputerCraft, Tech Reborn, Industrial Revolution, and Applied Energistics.
 
- Craft powerful tools with [hephaestus](https://modrinth.com/mod/hephaestus).
  
- Explore a beautiful new world with [terrestria](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrestria), [traverse](https://modrinth.com/mod/traverse), would, and Grounded.
  
- Cook and prepare food with Farming Delight and its addons.
  
- Build cool houses with [Chisel](https://modrinth.com/mod/chisel-reborn), [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped), and [Cluttered](https://modrinth.com/mod/cluttered).
  
- Or explore space with [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra).
